_note: English renderings of the 適情雅趣 (Elegant Pastime Manual) composition names, authored by hand. byNumber is keyed by the composition's number in the manual, byTitle by its four-character Chinese name. The two batches were produced separately and cover different compositions. Extended 2026-09-15 with the composition manuals mined that week (百局象棋谱, 湖涯集, 蕉窗逸品, 蕉竹斋, 隐秀斋, 橘中秘 endgames, 心武残编, 梦入神机); an existing rendering always wins over a later one, so cross-book duplicates of a name share one English.
